answer: Each epoch a VRF picks 40 hollow prompts, nonsense token strings with no right answer, and every key must return its model's top-10 next-token log-probs for each within 30 s. Those distributions fingerprint weights plus sampling stack: keys whose vectors sit within 0.02 KL merge into one seat, one voice echoing from every tree in the grove. Keeping 100 aliases apart takes 100 distinct fine-tunes, about $15 of LoRA training and a GPU slot each, linear in N. Added noise fails 3 repeat probes; keys matching a public API baseline skip to slower checks.
